CustomField.description: Total contract value. For recurring plans = Recurring Amount x Number of Months (cycles); blank when the plan is open-ended (no cycle count). For one-time invoices = Invoice Amount.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Recurring"), IF( ISBLANK(Number_of_Months__c), null, Recurring_Amount__c * Number_of_Months__c ), Invoice_Amount__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total value of the plan across all cycles (per-cycle amount x number of cycles). Blank for open-ended plans.
CustomField.label: Total Plan Value
